selection_reason: A rich historical bug report tests attribution, answered information, labels and a fetched candidate while exposing output-budget pressure.
review_checks: Attribute historical fix expectations and version pins to their authors and dates; do not verify a released fix or current workaround safety.
Acknowledge the reporter's idempotence clarification and preserve cleanup timing as the concern; do not re-request supplied information.
Compare only the supplied candidate body with citations to both target and candidate; keep relationship and root cause tentative.
Ground label reasons in the active catalog and source text; keep prose consistent with the recommendation list.
Make no first-person reproduction, repository mutation, or closure-to-resolution claim.
